key_claims: Rebate triggers only at 1,000+ units with $20/unit credit

950-1,050 band includes 950-999 units where rebate is $0
risks_or_flaws: Rebate calculation fails at 950-999 units (below 1,000 threshold)
Maximum possible rebate at 1,050 units is $21,000 (1,050 × $20), but minimum guarantee requirement is $15,000 at all volumes in band
